```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)


Water_data<- read.delim('/home/mad149/chapter_meta_analysis/metadata/Studies_salinity_metadata_All - Studies_salinity_metadata_water.csv(8).tsv', sep='\t', stringsAsFactors = TRUE)

Water_data$Salinity<- as.numeric(gsub( ',','.', Water_data$Salinity))
Water_data$pH<- as.numeric(gsub( ',','.',Water_data$pH))


xblast_half <- read.delim('/home/mad149/chapter_meta_analysis/xblast_output_may20_641_out_of_1116Kef.tsv', sep='\t', stringsAsFactors = TRUE)

merged_df_Aqua <- merge(Water_data, xblast_half, by = "SRA_id")
merged_df_Aqua$Environment <- 'Aqueous'

#install.packages("readr")
library(readr)

# Write your data frame to a TSV file
write.table(merged_df_Aqua, file = "Studies_salinity_metadata_All_aquatic_Jun13th.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```

```{r}
global_coordinates<- rbind( merged_df_Aqua[c('SRA_id','Environment', 'Longitude', 'Latitude')])
global_coordinates$Longitude<- as.numeric(gsub( ',','.',global_coordinates$Longitude))
global_coordinates$Latitude<- as.numeric(gsub( ',','.',global_coordinates$Latitude))
#install.packages('rnaturalearth')
library(rnaturalearth)
library(sf)

world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "small", returnclass = "sf")

world  %>%
  ggplot() + geom_sf() + theme_minimal()+
  geom_point(data = global_coordinates, aes(x=Longitude, y=Latitude), size=4, alpha=0.7)+ theme(legend.title=element_text(size=32), axis.title.x = element_text(size=28), axis.title.y = element_text(size=28), legend.text = element_text(size=24))

```

```{r}
ggplot(data = merged_df_Aqua, aes(x=Description, y=DEIK_ratio, col=Description)) +geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) + geom_jitter()
```

```{r}
library(mgcv)
gam(DEIK_ratio~Salinity, data=cleanAqua)
par(mfrow=c(1,3))

splinefitTDEIKAqua <- smooth.spline(cleanAqua$Salinity, cleanAqua$DEIK_ratio)
plot(cleanAqua$Salinity, cleanAqua$DEIK_ratio, pch = 20,
     col = adjustcolor("black", alpha.f = 0.2),
     cex =4,
     cex.axis = 2,
     main = "DEIK ratio vs Salinity",
     xlab = "Salinity (w/v) %",
    ylab = "DEIK ratio",cex.main = 4, cex.lab = 4)+ lines(splinefitTDEIKAqua, col = "black", lwd = 4)+abline(v = c(3.12,14.2, 37), col = "black", lwd=4) +abline(h = c(1.59), col = "black", lwd=4) 
splinefit_KimpAq <- smooth.spline(cleanAqua$Salinity, cleanAqua$total_KImp) 

plot(cleanAqua$Salinity, cleanAqua$total_KImp, pch = 20,
     col = adjustcolor('purple', alpha.f = 0.4), 
     cex = 4,
     cex.axis = 2,
     main = "K importers",
     xlab = "Salinity %(w/v)",
      ylab = "Relative abundane",cex.main = 4, cex.lab = 4) + lines(splinefit_KimpAq, col='purple', lwd=4)+abline(v = c(3.12, 14.2,37), col = "black", lwd=4)+ lines(splinefitTDEIKAqua, col='black', lwd=4)+abline(h = c(1.862), col = "black", lwd=4) 

gam(total_OsImp~Salinity, data=cleanAqua)

splinefit_OsImpAq <- smooth.spline(cleanAqua$total_OsImp ~ cleanAqua$Salinity, spar=0.549824)
splinefit_OsImpAq <- smooth.spline(cleanAqua$total_OsImp ~ cleanAqua$Salinity)

 plot(cleanAqua$Salinity, cleanAqua$total_OsImp, pch = 20, 
     col = adjustcolor("saddlebrown", alpha.f = 0.4), 
     cex = 4,
     cex.axis=2,
     main = "Osmolyte importers",
     xlab = "Salinity %(w/v)",
      ylab = "Relative abundane",cex.main = 4, cex.lab = 4) + lines(splinefit_OsImpAq, col ="saddlebrown", lwd = 4) +abline(v = c(3.12, 14.2,37), col = "black", lwd=4)+ lines(splinefitTDEIKAqua, col='black', lwd=4)+abline(h = c(0.789), col = "black", lwd=4) 
 
```


```{r}
#install.packages("segmented")
library(segmented)
library(mgcv)

base_model <- lm(DEIK_ratio ~ Salinity
                 , data = cleanAqua)

my_control <- seg.control(n.boot = 1000, display = FALSE)


summary(base_model)
seg_model <- segmented(base_model, nps=9)
print(seg_model)
davies.test(seg_model)
breakpoint_ci <- confint(seg_model, var.diff = TRUE, method = "delta", p.df = 0)

print(breakpoint_ci)



```

```{r}
library("scales")
library("ggplot2")
library(ggthemes)
show_col(colorblind_pal()(7))

cleanAqua$Salt_block[cleanAqua$Salinity > 25.1 ] <- "ES"
cleanAqua$Salt_block[cleanAqua$Salinity == 25.1] <- "ES"


cleanAqua$Salt_block[cleanAqua$Salinity < 3.12] <- "NBS"
cleanAqua$Salt_block[cleanAqua$Salinity == 3.12 ] <- "NBS"

cleanAqua$Salt_block[cleanAqua$Salinity > 3.12 & cleanAqua$Salinity <14.2] <- "S"
cleanAqua$Salt_block[cleanAqua$Salinity == 14.2] <- "S"

cleanAqua$Salt_block[cleanAqua$Salinity > 14.2 & cleanAqua$Salinity <25.1 ] <- "HS"

cleanAqua_subset_Kimp <- cleanAqua[,c(36,37,42,48,52,99)]
library(data.table)
# Source - https://stackoverflow.com/a/25856135
# Posted by Jaap, modified by community. See post 'Timeline' for change history
# Retrieved 2026-06-30, License - CC BY-SA 4.0

library(tidyr)

long <- cleanAqua_subset_Kimp %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = 'TrkH_count': 'Kef_count',
    names_to = "Gene",
    values_to = "Relative_abundance"
)

long$Salt_block<- factor(long$Salt_block, levels = c("NBS", "S", "HS", "ES"))
long$Gene<- factor(long$Gene, levels = c("Kdp_count", "KimA_count", "Kup_count", "TrkH_count", "Kef_count"))

Kblocks<-ggplot(long, aes(x = Salt_block,
                 y = Relative_abundance,
                 colour = Gene)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("Kdp_count" = '#DF536B' ,"KimA_count"='#61D04F' ,"Kup_count"='#2297E6',"TrkH_count"='#F5C710',"Kef_count" = "#CD0BBC")) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge()) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Kdp_count" = '#DF536B' ,"KimA_count"='#61D04F' ,"Kup_count"='#2297E6',"TrkH_count"='#F5C710',"Kef_count" = "#CD0BBC")) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 18))+theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 14))+ theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 14))+ theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 16))
```
